heading: PROJECTS
description: Every active Elixpo project, service and research record I have built, plus my maintainer work at Pollinations and completed systems research. The full lifecycle-aware directory lives at elixpo.com/projects. Star counts are a snapshot from 27 October 2026.

projects.name: pollinations
projects.description: An open-source generative AI platform where I maintain contributor rewards, triage automation, application workflows, model curation, and developer tooling.

projects.name: crumb.elixpo
projects.description: A self-hosted Rust terminal agent with explicit permissions, isolated tools, supervised MCP execution, signed skill distribution, rollback, and revocation. Debian packaging is in progress on Salsa (ITP #1151280); its execution-receipt workflow remains under validation.

projects.name: search.elixpo
projects.description: An OpenAI-compatible web-search and research system with Redis-backed conversational memory, semantic caching, retrieval, MCP tools, streaming responses, citations, and reproducible evaluation artifacts.

projects.name: packages.elixpo
projects.description: The source, release, signed APT distribution, and public catalogue for independently versioned Elixpo Linux applications, with candidate deployments and rollback documentation. Selected for the XERJ Corpus Hub (in licence review).

projects.name: agent.elixpo
projects.description: Elixpo's organization-wide GitHub operations agent for deterministic triage, Project V2 automation, permission-checked metadata actions, comment-only reviews, and merge records.

projects.name: status.elixpo
projects.description: A Cloudflare-native status surface that derives service health from observed traffic, distinguishes outages from unavailable monitoring, and publishes operational history across Elixpo.

projects.name: qfabric
projects.description: A research runtime for measured recovery across Linux and RTOS execution domains, with timing contracts, safe switching, replayable decisions, probation, and rollback.

projects.name: blogs.elixpo
projects.description: An operated, community-developed publishing platform with real-time collaborative editing, multi-tenant publications, Markdown, SEO, and API and CLI automation on Cloudflare.

projects.name: sketch.elixpo
projects.description: An open SVG whiteboard engine and React canvas with a hand-drawn visual system for sketches, diagrams, documents, and presentations.

projects.name: accounts.elixpo
projects.description: Shared OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect identity infrastructure for Elixpo services, with SSO, passkeys, webhooks, and an edge-safe TypeScript SDK.

projects.name: oreo
projects.description: An open hardware badge, operated site, and research platform running OreoOS: a MicroPython OS for an ESP32-S3 with apps, OTA updates, device drivers, KiCad hardware, and a DMA-aware RGB565 video pipeline.

projects.name: lixrl.com
projects.description: Short links, managed redirects, analytics, and production-ready QR codes, with custom domains, API access, and a developer CLI.

projects.name: mails.elixpo
projects.description: Shared email infrastructure for Elixpo services: templates, API- and webhook-triggered sends, delivery logs, and bring-your-own SMTP on Cloudflare's edge.

projects.name: payouts.elixpo
projects.description: Shared operational tooling for tracked payout workflows across Elixpo programmes.

projects.name: admin.elixpo
projects.description: The operational administration surface for inspecting and running the Elixpo service network, with privileged functions kept restricted.

projects.name: me.elixpo
projects.description: Standalone, JSON-driven portfolios for people whose work forms part of Elixpo, statically exported to the edge.

projects.name: monodiffuse
projects.description: Controlled experiments in one-bit diffusion: native binary-weight training, PTQ/QAT ablations, calibrated evaluation, packed checkpoints, and runnable ONNX artifacts.

projects.name: octabit
projects.description: A programmable RISC-style 8-bit computer built and documented on breadboards, with transistor and TTL logic, EEPROM microcode, and schematics.

projects.name: wozformer
projects.description: Active research into language-model inference on a 1 MHz 6502 under severe SRAM and EEPROM constraints.
